display_long_description:
**IPTV Smart Cast** combines an elegant interface with advanced tools to ensure the best playback, free from buffering in your virtual theater.

### Exclusive Features:

* **📺 Chromecast Support:** Watch Movies/Series on the big screen! Cast VOD content to your Chromecast with a single click.
* **🚀 Maximum Performance:** Unleash full power with Hardware Acceleration decoding, ensuring smooth playback at high resolutions.
* **🛡️ Built-in DNS Switcher:** Is your ISP throttling? Change DNS settings in-app (Google, Cloudflare, AdGuard) to improve connectivity.
* **🎬 Premium VOD Experience:** Organize your library with official posters, detailed synopses, and cast info.
* **⏯️ Resume Playback:** Started a movie and had to leave? The app remembers exactly where you left off.
* **🔄Synchronized Playback:** The host controls play, pause, and seek, ensuring everyone stays on the same frame.
* **🎙️Voice Chat Integration:** Connect your Agora ID in settings to talk with your friends in real-time while you watch.

### Essential Features:

* **Xtream Codes Connection:** Fast login using only URL, Username, and Password.
* **Electronic Program Guide (EPG):** View real-time scheduling for every channel.
* **Favorites Manager:** Create your custom list of preferred channels.
* **Modern Interface:** User-centric design optimized for a seamless experience.

> **Disclaimer:**
**IPTV Smart Cast IS A MEDIA PLAYER AND DOES NOT PROVIDE CONTENT. Users need access credentials (User/Pass/URL) compatible with Xtream Codes API, and are responsible for content used.**
